title: Document or shorten the host-shutdown watch guard held across queued provider startup
outcome: Prevent future nested watch reads from creating a shutdown deadlock and document or reduce the blocking latency of host-shutdown publication across queued provider startup, while preserving the promotion/shutdown ordering.
acceptance: The promotion critical region either documents its no-nested-watch-read invariant with the relevant call boundary or uses an equivalent synchronization strategy that avoids the long watch read guard.
Validation demonstrates that host shutdown still fences actual promotion and does not fence unrelated prompts on M4 supervisor-only stopping; any claimed latency improvement is measured.
